bundle_summary: Two defensible directions emerge: (1) goth/horror-themed phone cases have direct search demand; (2) a pastel goth audience cluster appears across multiple apparel-focused queries and merits validation on POD-friendly surfaces. Most other candidates are seller-supply or digital-only and do not support POD validation.
bundle_warnings: Many candidates are seller-supply or digital-only and cannot validate POD niches (png, svg, 3D-printed frames, apparel/jewelry/accessories, furniture applique, vtuber assets).
Potential presence of licensed horror IP within phone case results requires careful non-IP validation.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Shoppers who like goth and horror aesthetics and want themed protective phone cases
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Direct product queries show demand for goth phone case (moderate volume/competition) and horror phone case (broader adjacent theme), indicating active niche interest.
hypotheses.label: Goth and horror themed phone cases
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy SERPs for 'goth phone case' and 'horror phone case'
Top-converting listing themes, imagery, and tag clusters
Shop/market saturation and pricing for goth/horror cases
hypotheses.uncertainty: Results may skew toward licensed horror IP; need to verify presence of generic, non-IP designs.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Shoppers identifying with pastel goth/soft goth aesthetics
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Multiple pastel goth apparel queries indicate a coherent subculture with purchase intent; needs validation on POD surfaces beyond apparel.
hypotheses.label: Pastel goth aesthetic audience with potential POD demand
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy SERPs for 'pastel goth phone case' and 'pastel goth poster'
Tag/keyword density around pastel goth on POD-friendly items
Listing volume and non-apparel placements in this aesthetic
hypotheses.uncertainty: Current evidence is apparel-heavy; demand may not translate to POD items like cases/prints.
